description: G1JoystickFlatTerrain BPTT, forlax train_g1_shac.py env config (reward_softness=0.05, softjax_mode=smooth, pw_solimp=[0,0.8,1,1,10], contact_st_enable=True), 256 envs, horizon 16, opt.iterations=3, seed 0, float32, RTX 5080 shared with one other job. Times in ms (median of 10), memory = XLA temp bytes of the fused value_and_grad. Produced by g1_env_bench.py; "remat" = jax.remat(env.step, prevent_cse=False) as in forlax remat_enable.

default (no remat).error: out of memory: fused gradient needs ~19.25 GiB

headroom_experiments.note: Solver patched at runtime; gradients of these runs are not valid, only their cost. identity_tangent replaces the matrix build + LU solve with y -> y (upper bound on tangent-solve optimizations); ckpt_solve wraps the ift solve in jax.checkpoint.
